test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

We have postponed this movie outing too many times, so we are going tomorrow, come _____ or shine.
solution:
The correct answer is '**rain**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "come rain or shine" is an idiom meaning that something will happen regardless of weather conditions or any other difficulties.
 
• The correct option "rain" fits well in this context to complete the idiom accurately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *We have postponed this movie outing too many times, so we are going tomorrow, come rain__ or shine.*
